# .github
Stores repository automation and GitHub-side deployment orchestration.
This folder owns Actions workflows and only the metadata needed to run them safely.
Use it for CI/CD logic, not for application runtime code.
一旦我所属的文件夹有所变化，请更新我。

| file name | position | function |
| --- | --- | --- |
| ARCH.md | folder contract | documents the GitHub automation area |
| workflows/ | automation folder | contains manual deployment workflows and future CI workflows |
